summary: The NMPA UDI database is a Chinese-language web query application. Where it answers at all it returns HTML with no machine interface and no bulk export; access is also frequently geo/UA restricted. No records were obtained.
official_identifier: UDI-DI as registered in the NMPA UDI database
unlock_route: NMPA UDI data is queryable only through https://udi.nmpa.gov.cn/ (human interface, Chinese ID/registration context). No official keyless API exists.
